title: What is Overrank?
summary: Overrank is a Roblox action RPG where you rise from a nobody to an S-rank awakened by clearing rifts, forging gear and beating guardians.

blocks.text: Overrank is an action RPG on Roblox, made by the AwaitLab studio. You are an awakened : a human whose mana woke up. Gates called rifts open in your city; you walk into one, fight through its rooms with your class and its skills, defeat the guardian at the end and collect shards , XP and gear.
blocks.html: Overrank is an action RPG on Roblox, made by the AwaitLab studio. You are an awakened: a human whose mana woke up. Gates called rifts open in your city; you walk into one, fight through its rooms with your class and its skills, defeat the guardian at the end and collect shards, XP and gear.

blocks.text: 15 classes : 7 you can pick freely and 8 special ones you have to earn (see Classes ). Rank E to S, S+ and Nation : your rank measures how strong you really are (see Progression path ). Gear that you forge : weapons, armor and accessories, with a forge that never destroys your item. Rifts of every rank , red anomaly rifts, rift breaks, double dungeons, guild raids and a seasonal event. PvP in the Colosseum and an Endless Tower for solo players. Guilds , a battle pass each season, daily rewards and codes.
